calibration.note: no calibration card (Phase 13 calibrated the champion only)

retrospective.note: no holdout number (no inputs under the Phase 05 seal, or not fitted)

tests.basis: phase_12 PREOPEN_TRAPS.json failures [] and REPLAY_AUDIT ok; cards load with their hashes; registry fingerprint

inference.probe_set: the 95 Solana decisions of the retrospective holdout per target (of 176 holdout decisions), inputs only (run_holdout.Inputs), no label

retrain_policy.reason: no scheduled job is approved (PI-D-005); a retrain is a phase step with a plan
retrain_policy.rollback: previous pinned champion whose checks hold, else NO_VIABLE_CHAMPION

triggers.DRIFT_ALERT: RETRAIN_AND_HUMAN_REVIEW: the model is not used until a reviewed retrain is registered
triggers.FACTS_MISMATCH: ROLLBACK_AND_INVESTIGATE: the entry's facts are not what its committed sources say
triggers.FACTS_NOT_VERIFIED: REQUEST_REFUSED: pass the repository root so the registry can rebuild the facts
triggers.FEATURE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: REQUEST_REFUSED: recompute the inputs with the model's feature set, or retrain
triggers.FIXTURE_IN_REAL_REGISTRY: ROLLBACK_AND_INVESTIGATE: a fixture entry was pinned outside a fixture run
triggers.INFERENCE_MISMATCH: ROLLBACK_AND_INVESTIGATE: the model no longer gives its recorded outputs
triggers.INFERENCE_NOT_CHECKED: REQUEST_REFUSED: recompute the champion's probe outputs and pass them
triggers.MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE_RETRAIN_REQUIRED: RETRAIN_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ANY_USE: the code changed under the model
triggers.MODEL_STALE: RETRAIN_PLAN_REQUIRED: a new frozen card from a plan committed before its evaluation data are read
triggers.TARGET_OR_LABEL_VERSION_CHANGE: RETRAIN_AND_REEVALUATE: a new target or label version is a new model

DRIFT_ALERT.detector: Page-Hinkley on matured champion Brier loss minus B0 loss, in maturity order
DRIFT_ALERT.rule: an alarm at or before the decision

FACTS_MISMATCH.rule: the champion's facts differ from what the committed files give

FACTS_NOT_VERIFIED.rule: serve was not given the repository root, so the champion's facts could not be rebuilt

FEATURE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.rule: the request's feature set sha or version differs from the entry's

FIXTURE_IN_REAL_REGISTRY.rule: a fixture champion outside a fixture run

INFERENCE_MISMATCH.rule: the recomputed identical-inference hash differs from the pinned one

INFERENCE_NOT_CHECKED.rule: serve was not given the champion's recomputed inference rows

MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE_RETRAIN_REQUIRED.rule: the running code's feature set, family version, target registry or labels version differs from the entry's (a change without retrain, P46)

MODEL_NOT_PROMOTED.rule: registry level not SHADOW or VALIDATED_EXPERIMENTAL

MODEL_STALE.rule: decision time minus training cutoff above max_model_age_s

RETROSPECTIVE_MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE_AS_OF.rule: decision time before the training cutoff
